author: evac
description: Role-holder daily photo-drop job: daily quota submissions, a streak, a strike system that controls a job role, PTO, an automatic weekly Photo of the Week poll, and a nightly owner rating pass (GOAT/Good/Mid/Bad) on every photo. The job role is the single source of truth for who can drop.
install_msg: Thanks for installing photodrop! Commands live under `.pp` or `.pockypolice`. Run `.pp set` (needs Manage Server) to open the settings panel: confirm the job role (it defaults to a hardcoded ID), pick the shared channel before anyone drops photos, and optionally the rating channel, rater, quota and strikes. `.pp hire @user` adds the role to get someone started. Browse rated photos with `.pp rated goat|good|mid|bad`.
short: Daily photo-drop job with a streak, a strike system, PTO, a weekly photo poll, and owner photo ratings.
